dedupe_keys.name: new caledonia mining cadastre cadastre minier dimenc public views

description: The public mining cadastre of New Caledonia, one of the largest nickel producers. The Georep open data page says the layer shows mining titles managed by the DIMENC mines and quarries service, and a companion layer shows zones where mining is forbidden. The data are free under the French Licence Ouverte, served as an ArcGIS FeatureService that can be queried or exported, and are updated through the year. Coverage is New Caledonia. Caveats: the page read does not give a last update date or a field list. For simulation it shows where nickel mining titles lie, for mapping supply of a critical mineral and the roads, ports and power links to mining sites, and for exposure of mines to cyclones and landslides. A related catalogue record is the CGS Indonesia nickel smelter dataset.
